name: 20090eab-e39c-417d-a181-142052ce81d5
description: Telco Voice Central: voice and chat agent for billing, technical support, sales and equipment, appointments and account management.

variableDeclarations.name: account_id
variableDeclarations.description: Account found by lookup_account. Empty until the caller is identified.

variableDeclarations.name: phone_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the account's phone number; safe to say aloud.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_provided_phone_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the phone number the caller actually gave on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: clid
variableDeclarations.description: 10-digit caller ID from telephony (prd.md section 5). lookup_account uses it when the caller gives no number. Empty in text chats.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_status
variableDeclarations.description: Login progress: none, code_sent, pass or locked. Only check_login_code or check_secret_pin sets pass.

variableDeclarations.name: login_code_sent
variableDeclarations.description: True once send_login_code has sent a code on the active account.

variableDeclarations.name: logged_in
variableDeclarations.description: True once check_login_code or check_secret_pin has verified the caller.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_failure_count
variableDeclarations.description: Wrong login codes or PINs so far on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: login_attempts
variableDeclarations.description: Wrong login attempts so far on this call (alias for auth_failure_count).

variableDeclarations.name: pin_failure_count
variableDeclarations.description: Wrong secret PINs so far on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: pin_attempts
variableDeclarations.description: Wrong secret PIN attempts so far on this call (alias for pin_failure_count).

variableDeclarations.name: payment_failure_count
variableDeclarations.description: Declined payment attempts so far on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: card_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the active payment card on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: declined_card_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the most recently declined card on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: payment_declined_once
variableDeclarations.description: True once a payment attempt has been declined on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: last_payment_method
variableDeclarations.description: Payment method used on the most recent successful payment attempt.

variableDeclarations.name: mock_error
variableDeclarations.description: Optional simulated backend error code for deterministic testing.

variableDeclarations.name: is_blocked
variableDeclarations.description: True when the caller phone number is on the blocked callers list.

variableDeclarations.name: language
variableDeclarations.description: Active BCP-47 language code for the call (en-US, fr-CA, es-US). Empty until detected or set.

variableDeclarations.name: preferred_language
variableDeclarations.description: Preferred language code on the caller's profile or detected from utterances.

variableDeclarations.name: last_user_utterance
variableDeclarations.description: Most recent user utterance text, when available.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Reason recorded when handing the caller over to a person.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_status
variableDeclarations.description: Handoff status: completed_via_specialist_queue when handover_to_person has run.

variableDeclarations.name: handover_complete
variableDeclarations.description: True once handover_to_person has run on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_message
variableDeclarations.description: Exact localized handover sentence to speak before ending the session.

variableDeclarations.name: last_tracking_id
variableDeclarations.description: Most recent reference number returned by a tool.

variableDeclarations.name: request_summary
variableDeclarations.description: Summary of the most recent submitted request.

variableDeclarations.name: identification_status
variableDeclarations.description: Pass once lookup_account found the caller's account (PRD §5).

variableDeclarations.name: business_flag
variableDeclarations.description: True when the account is a business account (business handoff).

variableDeclarations.name: customer_type
variableDeclarations.description: New or Existing, from the account profile.

variableDeclarations.name: region
variableDeclarations.description: Region-A, Region-B or Region-C, for coverage and outage lookups.

variableDeclarations.name: service_status
variableDeclarations.description: active, suspended_nonpayment, suspended_lost_stolen or suspended_travel.

variableDeclarations.name: login_channel
variableDeclarations.description: sms or email: where the last verification code went.

variableDeclarations.name: code_purpose
variableDeclarations.description: login or step_up: what the last verification code is for.

variableDeclarations.name: step_up_verified
variableDeclarations.description: True once the emailed step-up code was verified (MFA changes).

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_context
variableDeclarations.description: JSON session context passed to the live agent (BR-TV-015).

variableDeclarations.name: global_err_count
variableDeclarations.description: Validation errors on this call; 3 ends in a too_many_errors handover.

variableDeclarations.name: local_noinput_counter
variableDeclarations.description: Consecutive silent turns on the current module.

variableDeclarations.name: no_match_confirmation_count
variableDeclarations.description: Unresolved clarification attempts on the current module.

variableDeclarations.name: misc_counter
variableDeclarations.description: Generic per-flow counter.

variableDeclarations.name: dtmf_digits
variableDeclarations.description: Keypad digits captured on the current turn.

variableDeclarations.name: call_channel
variableDeclarations.description: voice on a live phone call (set by the before-model callback from the phone gateway's session-start event or keypad input); empty in text chats.

variableDeclarations.name: sms_sent
variableDeclarations.description: Comma list of text messages sent on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: mock_mode
variableDeclarations.description: PRD §17 eval-harness flag. Defaults to True in this graded app so every session runs tools in mock mode; set the default to False for a production deployment.

variableDeclarations.name: lob
variableDeclarations.description: Line of business: mobility, internet, tv, homephone or smarthome.

variableDeclarations.name: tv_sub_type
variableDeclarations.description: streaming, satellite or streaming_only.

variableDeclarations.name: route
variableDeclarations.description: Module handling the caller's current goal.

variableDeclarations.name: utterance
variableDeclarations.description: The caller's latest goal in their own words, for topic switches.

variableDeclarations.name: last_pmt_amt
variableDeclarations.description: Last payment amount on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: amount
variableDeclarations.description: Amount currently under discussion.

variableDeclarations.name: ticket_state
variableDeclarations.description: open, in_progress or closed for the ticket under discussion.

variableDeclarations.name: vr_task_count
variableDeclarations.description: Virtual-repair steps sent on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: applied_adjustments
variableDeclarations.description: Comma list of credits applied on this call (no double credits).

variableDeclarations.name: sales_orders
variableDeclarations.description: Comma list of plan ids ordered on this call (place_order idempotency).

variableDeclarations.name: sales_claims
variableDeclarations.description: Comma list of warranty claim ids filed on this call (no duplicate claims).

variableDeclarations.name: sales_transfers
variableDeclarations.description: Comma list of number transfer ids started on this call (no duplicate ports).

variableDeclarations.name: pending_confirmation
variableDeclarations.description: The action waiting for the caller's confirmation.

variableDeclarations.name: mfa_state
variableDeclarations.description: Two-step verification state set by manage_mfa this call (enabled or disabled); empty = backend value.

variableDeclarations.name: password_reset_count
variableDeclarations.description: Password reset texts sent on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: cancelled_services
variableDeclarations.description: Comma list of lob:mode cancellations or port-outs submitted this call.

variableDeclarations.name: contact_updates
variableDeclarations.description: Comma list of contact-detail updates applied this call.

variableDeclarations.name: fx_pin_on_file
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: the 4-digit PIN on file (empty = login ladder).

variableDeclarations.name: fx_otp_on_file
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: the code carried by the last text (empty = login ladder).

variableDeclarations.name: fx_card_on_file_status
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: valid, declined or expired.

variableDeclarations.name: fx_service_status
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: active or a suspension reason (empty = suspended_nonpayment, reported by billing tools only).

variableDeclarations.name: fx_recent_payment
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: none or posted_yesterday (empty = posted_yesterday, found only by verify_payment_and_restore).

variableDeclarations.name: fx_business_account
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: true for a business account.

variableDeclarations.name: fx_outage_status
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: empty (regional table), active or none.

variableDeclarations.name: fx_technician_status
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: scheduled, en_route, delayed or en_route_delayed (empty = en_route_delayed).

variableDeclarations.name: fx_duplicate_payment
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: true when the ledger shows a duplicate payment (empty = true).

variableDeclarations.name: fx_extra_bill_line
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: extra bill line as description|amount|lob.

variableDeclarations.name: fx_device_warranty
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: in_warranty or out_of_warranty.

variableDeclarations.name: fx_mfa_enabled
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: true or false (empty = opposite of the request).

variableDeclarations.name: fx_sms_delivery
variableDeclarations.description: Backend fixture: delivered or failed.

variableDeclarations.name: outage_active
variableDeclarations.description: True when the last outage check found an active outage for the caller's service.

variableDeclarations.name: vr_session_id
variableDeclarations.description: Virtual-repair session reference opened on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: appt_state
variableDeclarations.description: Change made to the technician visit on this call: rescheduled or cancelled.

variableDeclarations.name: appt_slot_id
variableDeclarations.description: Slot the technician visit was moved to on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: appt_note
variableDeclarations.description: Note left for the technician on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: booked_slot_id
variableDeclarations.description: Slot of a technician visit booked on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: balance_due
variableDeclarations.description: Live account balance on this call after billing tools changed it (2 decimals); empty = backend value.

variableDeclarations.name: past_due_amount
variableDeclarations.description: Live past-due amount on this call after billing tools changed it (2 decimals); empty = backend value.

variableDeclarations.name: autopay_enrolled
variableDeclarations.description: True once setup_autopay enrolled the account on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: autopay_method
variableDeclarations.description: Autopay method set on this call: card_on_file, new_card or bank_account.

variableDeclarations.name: arrangement_active
variableDeclarations.description: True once setup_payment_arrangement created an arrangement on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: bill_payment_count
variableDeclarations.description: Bill payments made on this call (keeps payment references unique).

variableDeclarations.name: recent_payment_applied
variableDeclarations.description: True once verify_payment_and_restore applied a posted payment on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: card_brand
variableDeclarations.description: Brand of the active payment card on this call (Visa, Mastercard...).

variableDeclarations.name: step_up_pending
variableDeclarations.description: True while an MFA change waits for its step-up code (email, or text when email is unavailable).

variableDeclarations.name: phone_derived
variableDeclarations.description: True when the phone on the identified record was derived from account digits; its ending is never spoken.
